component: Analysis board: permanent chrome above the board
explanation: Owner: a Not analysed bar sits above the board, hard to read and consuming the vertical space the board needs; the evaluation bar was horizontal above the board; resize and settings sat in a large container strip beside it. When a page has a dominant interactive object, the workspace must be designed around it: nothing permanent above or below it, controls beside it or on hover, so it can grow to the edges of the window.

classification.rationale: Candidate P23 (PR-0002) keeps the primary region primary but does not forbid permanent headers, status bars or toolbars above and below it, nor say the region may grow to the window edges. Suggested: extend it into a primary-object layout rule, and state the touch exception. Owner decides.
